Perform TWA/STEL or task-based assessments where applicable; compare results with requirements and recognized occupational exposure limits; immediately escalate significant or abnormal findings to the IH Lead. IH Equipment, Sampling & Data Quality Maintain IH instruments and sampling equipment in operational readiness. Conduct kitchen, dining, welfare and camp hygiene inspections; support food/water sampling and follow-up of laboratory results and corrective actions Respiratory Protection, Operational Support & Assurance Support the Respiratory Protection Program: conduct hazard-based respirator selection, quantitative fit testing, user instruction and recordkeeping; verify appropriate filters/cartridges and coordinate medical evaluation/clearance requirements with the MOH medical team. title: Vice President, Global Environmental, Health, and Safety
description: TPI Composites, a trusted, long-term manufacturing partner to the global wind energy market, provides high-quality, cost-effective composite wind blades backed by advanced manufacturing capabilities and our proprietary, AI driven BladeAssure™ validation platform. TPI is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, operates factories in the U.S. and Mexico and has an engineering development center in Denmark with global service operations in the U.S., Mexico, and EU. Job Description Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Vice President, Environmental Health, Safety and Sustainability provides strategic direction and leadership for TPI’s environmental, health & safety programs. The incumbent is responsible for the continuous development and effective implementation of Safety Policies and Procedures. In addition, the incumbent leads the company’s sustainability program. He/she leads a team of safety professionals to drive and ensure a proactive safety culture across the organization as well as best in class sustainability practices. Key stakeholders include regional business leaders, customers as well as the Senior Leadership team at TPI Responsibilities & Accountabilities Drive a proactive safety culture across the organization Design, implement, and continuously improve enterprise-wide environmental, health & safety strategy and programs consistent with industry best practices, Define short and long term objectives to achieve company safety and sustainability goals and implement KPI’s, monthly reporting and business reviews to communicate progress Assess and drive implementation of optimal health & safety organizational structure, tools, training, programs, governance, and accountability models Leads efforts of safety organization through matrix leadership Provide technical expertise and thought leadership, create synergies and leverage knowledge, personnel, best practices, and resources across the organization Support the company’s US Worker’s Compensation Program effectively. This includes a focus on effective case management, return-to-work programs, and similar relative to work related illness and injuries. Ensure compliance with all environmental, health, and safety standards Monitor and facilitate the progress of environmental sustainability programs and governance systems, consistent with strategies, goals, measurements and reporting standards Lead the organization to behave with a sense of urgency, ensure that it is aligned and attracts the best talent Coordinate the executive level engagement between regions, customers and senior stakeholders Leverage synergies across various sites and participates/leads in sharing best practices Coach and mentor supply chain professionals across the organization Create and promote a culture of collaboration, team-work and fun while delivering to or exceeding expectations Who we are looking for: Minimum Education and Experience Bachelor's Engineering Degree in risk management, industrial Safety and Health, Safety engineering, Safety management, or closely related field 10-15 years’ leadership experience in regional or global manufacturing environment Knowledge and expertise in safety requirements in international locations (Americas and Europe) Proven ability to lead diverse safety teams to achieve organizational objectives Experience in the interpretation and enactment of Safety standards in OSHA and other global regulations Demonstrated ability to establish, implement, and manage best practice environmental, health & safety programs Familiarity with ISO 9001/14001/18001 implementation and program sustainability Ability to lead in a matrix environment Highly developed interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with employees at all levels of the organization. Highly effective presentation and training delivery skills Demonstrated ability to quickly establish credibility and lead by influence across all levels of the organization, from senior leadership to individual contributors This is a remote, U.S.-based role with willingness and ability to travel internationally to manufacturing sites. Build an effective team committed to organizational goals; foster collaboration among team members. Solution oriented, proactive approach and attitude in resolving issues without compromising quality Strong leadership, mentoring, organizational and communication skills Required Skills and Education - 15+ Years Management/Supervision Experience - Leadership experience in global manufacturing operations required Preferred Skills and Education -Experience in global organization -Experience leading teams through impact/influence -Experience in large scale industrial manufacturing

title: Construction & Camp Supervisor
company: ILF Consulting Engineers in United Arab Emirates
description: Join Us as Construction & Camp Supervisor We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Construction & Camp Supervisor to join one of our strategic pipeline projects in Basra, Iraq. The role is responsible for overseeing project camps, accommodation facilities, site offices, welfare services, and operational support activities while coordinating with the Client, Contractors, and Service Providers to ensure compliance with project requirements, HSE standards, and contractual obligations. The position will act as the focal point for the day-to-day management of camp operations, facilities maintenance, personnel welfare, site logistics support, office infrastructure, and accommodation arrangements for project personnel mobilized to various project locations. Key Responsibilities Supervise the day-to-day operation and administration of project camps, accommodation facilities, site offices, and common welfare areas. Coordinate construction support and facility interfaces involving temporary works, accommodation units, offices, utilities, access, laydown or common areas, and related site services. Coordinate with the Client, contractors, and service providers regarding accommodation, office space, utilities, internet, transportation, catering, housekeeping, laundry, cleaning, waste management, and other agreed support services. Monitor contractors and service providers against project requirements and contractual obligations; verify service quality and follow up deficiencies, complaints, and corrective actions to closure. Manage room allocation, occupancy records, check-in and check-out arrangements, accommodation capacity, and forward planning for mobilizing and demobilizing personnel. Support personnel mobilization and demobilization, including accommodation, transportation, site access coordination, onboarding support, and liaison with HR, HSE, Logistics, and Administration. Conduct routine inspections of accommodation units, kitchens, dining areas, offices, welfare facilities, utilities, fire and life-safety systems, recreational areas, and general camp conditions. Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of camp infrastructure, buildings, equipment, utilities, furniture, and office facilities to maintain safe and reliable operations. Support office and temporary-facility setup, including furniture, equipment, IT and connectivity requirements, utilities, and readiness for project use. Ensure activities comply with approved plans, project procedures, HSE requirements, camp rules, welfare standards, emergency arrangements, evacuation plans, and client expectations. Monitor site and camp readiness, operational risks, delays, resource constraints, and safety or welfare concerns; report and escalate matters promptly to the responsible project function. Maintain accurate records of occupancy, inspections, incidents, maintenance requests, complaints, inventory, service performance, and corrective actions. Prepare weekly and monthly status reports covering camp operations, accommodation capacity, facility readiness, contractor performance, outstanding actions, and operational support matters. Support client, project, and HSE audits and inspections and ensure that requested evidence and corrective-action records are properly maintained. Liaise with Project Management, Construction, HR, HSE, Logistics, Administration, contractors, subcontractors, service providers, and relevant client representatives. Qualifications & Experience Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Facilities Management or a related field. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in camp management, facilities management, construction site administration, accommodation operations, workforce welfare, or project support services on major oil and gas, pipeline, infrastructure, PMC, EPC, or construction projects. Practical experience coordinating contractors, service providers, maintenance activities, site logistics, workforce accommodation, offices, and welfare services. Previous experience in Iraq, the GCC, or remote construction camps is highly preferred. Experience supporting large, multicultural project workforces is an advantage. Additional HSE, fire safety, first aid, facilities management, or related certifications are advantageous. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Arabic language capability is an advantage. Skills & Competencies Strong camp, facilities, site-support, and contractor-management capabilities. Good understanding of accommodation operations, welfare services, basic construction interfaces, facilities maintenance, utilities, and site logistics. Working knowledge of HSE inspections, incident reporting, emergency response, fire and life safety, and camp welfare requirements. Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, resolve operational issues, and follow actions through to completion. Strong communication, problem-solving, conflict-resolution, planning, reporting, and record-keeping skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and able to maintain clear trackers, inspection records, and status reports. Rotation & Work Schedule Location: Basra, Iraq Rotation Pattern: Flexible rotational assignment based on project requirements Rotational travel, accommodation, transportation, and site logistics will be provided in accordance with company policies. Interested candidates who are currently based in Iraq or willing to relocate to Basra are encouraged to apply.

title: Environment Health Safety Lead
description: About Us PEG is an international engineering and contracting company with a presence across selected strategic geographies. With over 50 years of proven experience , PEG delivers process design, engineering solutions, and project management services across the Oil & Gas, Power Generation, and Renewables sectors. Our capabilities cover the full project lifecycle, from conceptual and front-end engineering design (FEED) and feasibility studies through detailed engineering, construction, commissioning and start-up, to operations and maintenance . About the Role Location: Iraq/ Basra and other project Locations Position: HSE Lead Key Responsibilities: Developing and implementing comprehensive health, safety, and environmental policies in accordance with legal and corporate guidelines. Conducting risk assessments to identify potential hazards and developing preventative strategies. Organizing safety training for employees to ensure awareness and understanding of safety and environmental practices and legislation. Monitoring compliance with policies, performing site inspections, and preparing detailed reports on findings. Leading emergency response initiatives and conducting investigations after incidents to establish causes and preventive measures. Advising on a range of specialist areas, e.g., fire regulations, hazardous substances, noise, occupational diseases, and waste management. Maintaining current knowledge of legislation and regulatory requirements related to health, safety, and environmental matters that impact the organization. Collaborating with internal leadership and external regulatory bodies to maintain compliance standards. Implementing health and safety plans that comply with company policies and legislated standards. Overseeing environmental performance and adherence to legal environmental standards. Handling safety/regulatory audits both internally and externally. Coordinating with HR departments to ensure physical examinations and medical clearances are completed per the company's policies. Developing and maintaining documentation related to HSE initiatives, such as inspection forms and training modules. Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Safety Management, or a related field. NEBOSH IGC certification Professional certifications such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) are highly desirable. Strong understanding of the legal health and safety guidelines relevant to the industry. Several years of experience in a HSE role, ideally within the industry or a closely related field. Proficient use of HSE management software and tools. What We Offer: Opportunity to work on strategically important Oil & Gas projects. International and multicultural working environment. Competitive compensation package. Professional growth and leadership opportunities within a dynamic project organization.
